name: Munshir Hat

queries.result: বাংলা first-party discovery found the DLRS map-search service and the Ministry of Land digital land-map portal. Official search material also identifies মুন্সির হাট as a postal/locality name in Bhola; no parcel polygon for the exact WUP point was exposed anonymously.

registryEvidence.basis: The first-party DLRS viewer is a public cadastral/map service under the Ministry of Land. Its current map-search JavaScript exposes division, district, survey, thana/upazila, mouza, sheet, parcel, boundary, per-sheet GeoJSON, and parcel vector-tile routes; the Bhola district is present in the Barisal division enumeration.
registryEvidence.localCustodianScope: Observed local administrative scope is Bhola district, Barisal division, with an official search result placing Munshir Hat in Burhanuddin upazila. The tested public data route did not return a usable Burhanuddin mouza list, so local cadastral coverage for this named locality remains unverified.

officialSources.observation: Current DLRS map-search page identifies the Government of Bangladesh land-record and survey authority and presents district, survey, thana/upazila, mouza, sheet and dag/plot selection controls.
Current Ministry of Land digital land-map portal states that mouza and plot map sheets are digitized and georeferenced; its public UI exposes division, district, upazila and mouza selectors.
Official Barisal education-board page gives the local administrative reference MUNSHIR HAT, Burhanuddin, Bhola.
DLRS guidance describes obtaining official mouza maps from the relevant upazila settlement office/publication camp.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service presence, Bhola district enumeration, and public route/schema behavior were verified. No exact-point or bounded city/locality parcel polygon was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. The public viewer's Bhola regular-survey thana routes returned empty arrays and the Diara route exposed only Kanchanpur/Tazumuddin; this is an access/coverage limitation, not evidence of citywide absence. No parcel ID, source schema, CRS, or geometry was observed. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
